commits.summary: Recheck organic Java R-series findings on releases (verification pending)
commits.body:
Replay the original compiled callers on 44 published deployments across 22 cases. Of 132 release outcomes, 131 reproduced their named original side exactly. Resilience4j 2.1.0 stopped silently where both PR pins and 2.2.0 announced an unscheduled retry. The Commons IO mark and Avro slice findings reproduced on releases, as did the default AssertJ record getter precedence. A fresh Commons IO mark also shortened from two readable characters to zero when moved two characters into the same input.

Forty-two extra public histories isolate duplicate-key transformer calls, mark offsets, Avro buffer forms and RxJava group publication order. Eighteen more ran the same Jackson callers on both pins with published companion libraries, reproducing every value and exception. All 25 affected example validators, 35 selected test suites, ten negative checks and both prior Spring release audits passed. The original 312-history replay and 32 debugger trials passed independently. Job 20261126-185408-repeat-the-organic-java-r-series-release repeats the 192 release and follow-up histories and requires byte-identical output.
